title: Ed May leads Stargate research in its final decade

plain: A researcher named Ed May is said to have run the research side of Stargate, a US government programme that studied whether people could use psychic means to spy on distant places, during its last ten years. The writer Eric Wargo tells this, without naming a source: May took over from the physicist Hal Puthoff and led the work until the programme was made public and, as Wargo puts it, "supposedly ended in 1995." The word "supposedly" hints that Wargo thinks the work may have gone on afterwards.
